tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: yi ge drug pa'i las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub ces ār+ya sa le'i thugs dam dril ba'i snying chos bzhugs so:

thugs dam gsang ba'i lha tshogs la// rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: yi ge drug pa'i gdams pa rta mchog rol pa'i rgyun khyer las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub bstan pa ni: e ma ho: las dang skal par ldan pa'i gang zag la: sku gsum las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub pa: pad+ma saṃ bha bdag gis gdams nas sbas: ma 'ongs bu yi lag tu 'byung bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngon 'gro phyir bsgyur bgegs la bka' bsgo bya: da la bum pa gtor tshogs rgyas par bshams: rang nyid bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung 'dug: skyabs yul sku gsum mdun du dmigs par bya: hrīḥ bde gshegs 'dus pa sku gsum grub pa'i lha: don gnyis mthar phyin rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas byang chub thob bya'i phyir: byams dang snying rje'i byang chub sems bskyed do: ces skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: na mo dharmā kā ya: nirma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: a we sha ya hriṃ hriṃ: ces byin dbab: ma hā sarba pū tsa gha ṇa tsakra ho: mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'o: de nas dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin gsum ni: hrīḥ chos dbyings rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las: kun snang 'gro la khyab pa snying rje'i mdangs: rgyu yi ngo bo hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni: hrīḥ 'byung ba rim brtsegs srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang : mtshan nyid kun rdzogs dbus su pad zla'i gdan: 'gags med rang snang pad nyi dgra bgegs steng : h+ya gh+ri wa ye shes dbang gi sku: 'bar ba'i me 'dra ye shes 'phro zhing brjid: zhal gcig khro gnyer smin 'khyug rdzi smar bskyod: ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan dmar gyen du g.yo: zhal nas khrag 'dzags dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje thod dbyug dar dpyangs gdengs: g.yon pas thugs khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang :

dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur mtsher zhing rngams: thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal dang : stag sham glang gos sbrul chun g.yang gzhir bcas: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan ldan gar dgur 'gying : g.yon nas 'khril ba'i rdo rje phag mo dmar: khro tshul chags bcas thod skam rin chen dang : rus pas brgyan cing gri thod yab la 'khyud: me long dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol zhing : g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums phag zhal skra grol ba: sgyu ma 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'i ngang : snang stong lha sku ye shes gnyis med gsal: thugs kar pad+ma zla steng 'od klong du: dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus snang mtha' yas: chags bral sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: don dam zhal gcig thabs shes phyag rgya zung : mtha' gnyis mi gnas skyil krung mnyam bzhag rgya: sku ni mtha' bral gtsug tor bltar mi mngon: 'gro la mchog rtsol lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang : rnam dag khrims ldan chos gos rnam gsum gsol: bdag gzhan don rdzogs mtshan dpe ldan par bsgom: spyi bor rje btsun pad+ma saṃ bha wa: rdo rje bhan+dha thabs shes phyag rgya gsal: paṇa zhu rna ring chos gos thang sham gsol: dmar smug mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar bar bsgom: lte bar gtum mo ye shes bde drod las: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal: rang bzhin lhun grub rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs: gdan dang phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs sku ru gsal: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hrīḥ gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ni: dkar dmar mthing ka rdo rje gsum gyi dngos: bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i 'od zer gyis: dbang chen lha tshogs 'od dpag med pa dang : gsang ba ye shes rje btsun gu ru rje: rta gdong phyag rgya'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren na: dbang gi rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrīḥ ye nas bdag dang gnyis med ye shes lha:

rang byung rang gsal ngang du brtan par bzhugs: bde gshegs sku gsum don gyi lha tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa ni: 'khor dang myang 'das phyi nang gsang ba yi: phyi nang gsang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro dang : reg bya chos sogs nam mkha' gang bar sprul: tshogs dang sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: bstod pa ni: hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem khro tshul gar dgur ldan: snyan 'tsher 'ur chom gseng bag gad rgyang can: thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshogs la bstod: bzlas pa bya ba ni: thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥyig las: gsang sngags snying po bar med 'du zhing 'phro: bdag gzhan don byas yi ge drug pa bzla: oṃ h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: grags stong so ma ma yengs bye ba bzla: rgyun du yi dam byas na lha ru 'gyur: skabs su snying po hrīḥbazlas 'khyer so bya: rang lus lha la sgra grags sngags kyi sgra: dran rtogs sku lnga ting 'dzin rgya mtsho gsal: de nas tshogs mchod ni: hrīḥ bskang rdzas tshogs kyi ma dag bsregs gtor sbyangs: yi ge gsum gyis byin rlabs ye shes bskyed: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: spyan 'dren mchod bshags bstab pa ni: hrīḥ ye shes lha tshogs 'dir byon tshogs la rol: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs phud yar bzhes la: zag med gha ṇa'i tshogs kyis bskang shing bshags: bag chags 'khor ba'i dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: gha ṇa tsakra pūts+tsha hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon la drang ba ni: hrīḥ rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i mched dang lcam: 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan du bzhes: lan 'debs pa ni: hrīḥhoḥ bdag dang dbyer med rtsa gsum don gyi lha: zag med bde ba'i zhal zas tshogs su rol: ma nu sarba sa ma ya badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes smon lam gdab: de nas lhag ma bya ba ni: a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs la:

hrīḥbh+yo: rang ngo ma shes rtog 'chal sgrib can kun: phud dang dpal gyi pha 'bab longs spyod rol: gsang sngags bstan dgra kha yi zas skal gyis: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhakā bhakā ye swā hā: bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ thabs shes sgyu ma'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dbyings rig ka dag rig pa'i thugs dam bskul: dug gsum dgra bgegs sku gsum klong du sgrol: ma rig rnam rtog skye med ngang du zlog: swa bha wa phaṭ: chad mdo brtan skyong ni: hrīḥ thog med dus nas da lta ma 'ongs tshe: sku gsum bde gshegs spyan sngar rang mdangs 'khor: brjod bral blo 'das chos 'khor rtag bskor tshe: rig rtsal mkha' 'gro dam can khas blangs bzhin: 'khor ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings sgrol ba'i: phrin las sgrub pa'i ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: ma ma yo gi nī ba liṃ ta khā hi: rta bro ni: hrīḥ chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i mkha' dbyings su: gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs ma lus gnon pa'i phyir: zhi khro'i gar ni 'khor 'das dbyings su sgyur: kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i gdon tshogs thal bar rlog: sarba s+t+wam+bha ya nan: bsngo ba smon lam ni: hrīḥ 'dus dang 'dus byas kun rdzob don dam chos: thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur bsngo'o: 'khor bar gnas pa'i ma gyur sems can kun: thams cad phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur cig: gshegs bsdu ni: hrīḥ bdag dang dam tshig ye shes gnyis med lha: nam yang mi gtong rgyun du bsten par bgyi: hrīḥyig ye shes lnga yi don la blta: stong gsal brjod bral rig sku mngon sum mthong : tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: bkra shis ni: hrīḥ sku gsum ye shes mi 'gyur don gyi lha: zhi dang khro gar gsang sngags rang sgra can: thugs rje'i mkha' khyab ye shes dkyil 'khor gyis: khams gsum sems can kun la bde legs stsol:

ces rgyas par 'dod na gzhung ltar bya'o: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs las rjes spyi mthun bya: zhes rtsa gsum snying po gcig drilayi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs las byang gi rim pa 'di: ār+ya sa le'i skye ba bdun rgyud du nyams su blangs pa'i rang chos 'di yang ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus de'i chos spyod kyi skal du sbas pa'o: zab rgya: : ghu h+yaḥ sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: bdag rang gi chos skal yin 'dra//
